plainText:
William Robert "Billy Bob" Thompson is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Thompson was born as William Robert Thompson sometime on January 22 in Vermont, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , specifically its fourteenth season. His most prominent role during that time was Burgh. Thompson then crossed over into the , where he gained the notable roles of Ash's Froakie, Frogadier, and Greninja; as well as Squishy, Z2, and Clemont's Luxray. Most recently, Thompson voiced the Tupp during the .
